messages:
marta: quick thought for console: add a lightweight "suggested filtersets" panel on route pages. idea is previewable filter bundles (model+tag+region) that show est cost/latency + coverage risk. want to run tradeoffs before RFC.

devon: sounds useful. are we generating candidates streaming or as batch jobs?

marta: hybrid: streaming flags cheap candidates, nightly batch runs fuller sims and scores. store compact suggestion records.

priya: must include sample size and CI in previews. otherwise folks will overfit to single-run numbers.

marta: agreed. preview payload should include: est_cost_delta_pct, p50/p95, ci bounds, n_samples, coverage_risk, and provenance_id.

alex: UX: show sparkline row with pre/post p50/p95 + token burn and small badges for "coverage risk" and "debias factor". clicking opens a trace panel with scoring inputs.

marta: sketch API for preview:
```
POST /api/v1/routes/{id}/filtersets/preview
body: { "candidates": ["model:small-quant","region:eu"], "window": "48h", "simulate": true }
returns: { "suggestion_id": "s-2026-42", "est_cost_delta_pct": "-9.3", "p50_ms": "14", "p95_ms": "78", "ci_cost": "[-12.1, -6.5]", "n_samples": "512", "coverage_risk": "low", "provenance_id": "trace-2026-42" }
```

priya: include a flag when sample has cold-start bias and a small examples array (PII-sanitized) so PMs can validate.

devon: approval rules: cost increase >10% or coverage_risk not low -> finance+owner approval. smaller changes are owner-fastapply.

ops-bot: stream-suggestions job finished for route r-web (job=stream-sugg-20260401-7).

alex: rollout modes: preview (UI only), canary (5-10% traffic, auto-monitor), full (immediate, may need approval). canary should attach a tiny live sparkline and allow 1-click rollback.

marta: telemetry must record scoring inputs (entropy, cold_start_frac, eval_delta) and a compressed sample snapshot referenced by provenance_id for reproducibility. store only PII-sanitized samples.

priya: also track suggestion metrics: adoption_rate, avg_cost_delta_realized, revert_rate_24h. use to tune thresholds and debiasing.

devon: edge case: narrowing models may hurt rare prompts. compute a coverage_test against a small prompt corpus and show coverage_loss_pct in preview.

marta: yep included: coverage_risk + sample examples. i'll write RFC with data model, preview API, apply flow, approval rules, telemetry snapshot schema, and metrics. can someone pick up a 2d spike for a mock panel?

alex: I can do a UI spike tomorrow.

marta: perfect, opening RFC after spike. :white_check_mark:
